شَرْحٌ inf. n. of 1. (S, O, &c.) ―
-b2- [An exposition, explanation, or interpretation, in the form of a running commentary, comprising the entire text of the work which it expounds; distinguished from a حَاشِيَة, which is a commentary only on particular words and passages: pl. شُرُوحٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
